title: 2026 General Election Endorsements
generalEvidence: "We strongly encourage you to vote in the November 3rd General Election ... The board of Illinois Family Action is pleased to endorse the following candidates in the 2026 General Election." (Oct. 17, 2026). Entries marked "Recommended" are the board's recommendations; quotes keep the label.
whyItCounts: Social-conservative advocacy group (pro-life, pro-family, religious-liberty positions); sister organization of Illinois Family Institute.
